narratives.body: LiveScore reports that AC Milan and Arsenal have made a move for Tresoldi, with a valuation of 60 million as early as January.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Tresoldi transfer interest

narratives.body: LiveScore, Yahoo Sports, FOX 44, The Straits Times, TNT Sports, and Ottumwa Courier report that Bournemouth defeated 10-man AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan received a red card, while Juventus was held to a draw.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League match results

narratives.body: LiveScore reports that Pavlovic insists Milan are on the right track even if too many mistakes were made.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Pavlovic on team progress
